description: 场景头配置（三层架构 L1）：空间布局/时间/光线/色调/轴线，每场景一次声明，结构化方位词替代自然语言段落；中英双语。

s1_cathedral.name: 中央教堂（封爵大典）
s1_cathedral.lighting: 晨光透过彩窗在石砖地面投下斑斓光斑；暖金烛光与冷白晨光混合
s1_cathedral.lighting_en: morning light through stained glass casting dappled patterns on the stone floor; warm candlelight blended with cool daylight
s1_cathedral.tone_en: high contrast, warm gold / cool white blend

spatial.front_center: 罗伊娜、伊索尔德并肩跪在红色绒毯上，面朝圣坛/主礼人、背对人群入口侧
spatial.mid_sides: 贵族分列左右，虚化站定，不抢主体
spatial.back_shadow: 珍妮芙位于人群阴影，黑兜帽、脸藏阴影、不露清晰正脸
spatial.back_high: 主礼人位于后景高台/圣坛前，暂不抢镜
spatial.camera_side: 入口侧（殿门内），观众看到跪地者后背/侧背
spatial.axis_lock: 镜头全程保持入口侧，轴侧恒定，禁止180度越轴

spatial_en.front_center: Rowena and Isolde kneel side by side on the red carpet, facing the altar/officiant, backs to the crowd-side entrance
spatial_en.mid_sides: nobles line both sides, blurred, not stealing focus
spatial_en.back_shadow: Genevieve in the crowd shadow, black hood, face hidden, no clear frontal face
spatial_en.back_high: the officiant at the rear altar, not yet claiming focus
spatial_en.camera_side: entrance side (inside the hall), audience sees the kneelers' backs / side-backs
spatial_en.axis_lock: camera stays on the entrance side throughout, axis constant, no 180-degree flip

s2_thorn_garden.name: 荆棘园（救白狼）
s2_thorn_garden.lighting: 冷蓝月光；荆棘剪影；白狼毛色反月光
s2_thorn_garden.lighting_en: cold blue moonlight; thorn silhouettes; the wolf's fur catching moonlight

spatial.environment: 黑色荆棘如铁网蔓延，月光下剪影
spatial.axis_lock: 保持180度轴线，人物相对站位恒定

spatial_en.front_center: Rowena and the White Wolf face each other
spatial_en.environment: black thorns spread like an iron net, silhouetted in moonlight
spatial_en.axis_lock: keep the 180-degree axis; character positions constant
